news.title: OakNorth Wins US Banking Approval After Building $3.5 Billion Lending Business
news.body: The Federal Reserve and OCC approved OakNorth’s acquisition of Michigan-based Community Unity Bank, enabling US deposit-taking and direct lending through the bank. OakNorth has lent approximately $3.5 billion to US businesses since entering the market in 2023, giving it an established lending base against which to build deposit relationships. The next milestone is deposit-account availability and pricing—and how much US lending those deposits fund.

news.title: MoonPay Seeks Trust Charter for Stablecoin Issuance, Redemption and Reserve Management
news.body: MoonPay filed an OCC national trust bank charter application on November 17 covering fiduciary custody, stablecoin issuance, redemption, reserve management and fiat-to-crypto conversion. The proposed institution would not take deposits or make commercial loans, distinguishing its intended role from a commercial bank. OCC approval and operating conditions would determine which services MoonPay can provide directly; the application itself does not change customer access.

news.title: PayPal Reassigns Venmo, Payments and Crypto Leadership as Finance Chief Departs
news.body: PayPal named Xero CFO Claire Bramley to replace Jamie Miller, who remains in her role until February 1, 2027, and reassigned leadership across consumer finance, Venmo, payments and crypto. Kartik Mani takes consumer financial services and Venmo, Suzan Kereere takes payment services and crypto, and Frank Keller retains branded checkout. Merchants and partners now have distinct business heads to assess against delivery schedules, while Aaron Webster’s departure leaves Ratinder Bedi leading risk on an interim basis.

news.title: Elliptic Links $149 Million in Bitcoin Mixing to Binance Hack
news.body: Elliptic identified $149 million in bitcoin coinjoin mixing linked to the Binance hack, with activity increasing sharply after November 17, according to The Block. Elliptic’s assessment that little stolen value has likely been cashed out makes subsequent transfers relevant to exchanges, custodians and crypto payment gateways screening incoming funds. Compliance teams can use updated wallet attribution to review exposure and monitor off-ramp activity; the $149 million measures mixing activity, not total theft or realized cash proceeds.

news.title: BILL Agrees to $6 Billion TPG Acquisition With Corpay as Partner
news.body: BILL announced a definitive agreement for TPG to acquire it in partnership with Corpay in a deal described as worth $6 billion. The transaction puts a finance platform serving nearly 500,000 businesses at the center of an ownership change relevant to accounting partners and business-payment providers. Customers and partners should assess closing conditions and Corpay’s precise participation before treating the agreement as a commitment to combine products or distribution.

perspective: OakNorth’s US approval and MoonPay’s trust-charter application lead today’s developments in banking access, payments leadership, crypto screening and business-finance consolidation.

curiosity.text: In 1974, the U.S. Federal Reserve began routing government payments through an electronic funds transfer system, allowing federal agencies to send recurring benefits directly to recipients’ bank accounts. That early program helped demonstrate how electronic payments could replace mailed paper checks at national scale. Source: Federal Reserve History, “The Fed’s Role in the Payment System” — https://www.federalreservehistory.org/essays/feds-role-in-the-payment-system
